publications.title: Oracle Table Lock Modes: SS, RS, SX, RX, S, SSX, SRX, X Made Easy
publications.description: A ten-page guide to Oracle table and transaction locks, enqueue modes, dictionary views, explicit locking, blocking sessions, and Enterprise Manager diagnostics.

publications.title: Exadata X3 in Action: Measuring Smart Scan Efficiency with AWR
publications.description: Explains how AWR wait events and statistics quantify Exadata Smart Scan offloading, Storage Indexes, Hybrid Columnar Compression, and Smart Flash Cache.

publications.title: Can We Actually Achieve NOLOGGING?
publications.description: Tests redo generation for NOLOGGING operations, direct-path inserts, indexes, and global temporary tables while separating data recovery from instance recovery requirements.

publications.title: Join Methods and 12c Adaptive Plans
publications.description: Reviews nested loop, hash, and sort-merge joins and demonstrates how Oracle 12c adaptive plans defer a join-method decision until runtime cardinalities are observed.

publications.title: Parallel Distribution and 12c Adaptive Plans
publications.description: Explains parallel query distribution choices, broadcast and hash redistribution, 12c adaptive hybrid hash distribution, and small-table replication.

publications.title: Setup a Standard Edition Standby in 1 Hour
publications.description: A six-page walkthrough of creating, scheduling, monitoring, and switching over a Dbvisit standby database for Oracle Standard Edition.

publications.title: CBO Choice Between Index and Full Scan: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly Parameters
publications.description: Traces Oracle optimizer costing from rule-based behavior to system statistics and explains why optimizer_index_cost_adj distorts index-versus-full-scan and adaptive join decisions.

publications.title: Star Transformation, 12c Adaptive Bitmap Pruning and In-Memory Option
publications.description: Demonstrates star transformation, bitmap indexes, temporary-table transformation, Oracle 12c adaptive bitmap pruning, and In-Memory bloom filters.

publications.title: 12c SQL Plan Directives
publications.description: Follows the lifecycle of Oracle 12c SQL Plan Directives from cardinality feedback through dynamic sampling and automatic column-group statistics.

publications.title: Testing Delphix: Easy Data Virtualization
publications.description: Evaluates Delphix database virtualization, incremental synchronization, point-in-time virtual databases, storage savings, provisioning, and testing use cases.

publications.title: Erreur d'I/O sur un datafile: crash d'instance ou datafile offline?
publications.description: Analyse en RAC et multitenant le comportement d'Oracle lors d'une erreur d'ecriture sur un datafile et le parametre _datafile_write_errors_crash_instance.

publications.title: Que gagneriez-vous en passant sur Exadata? Partie I - Mesurez l'activite eligible au SmartScan
publications.description: Explique comment mesurer dans Statspack ou AWR les lectures directes eligibles au Smart Scan et comment utiliser les statistiques de simulation Exadata.
